nodes.title: Pack-current limit 100 A
nodes.text: ArduPilot Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX = 100 A (with the power module's current sensor calibrated) caps the summed motor current

nodes.title: Fallback cruise speed 17 m/s (D-96 c, CDR decision B6)
nodes.text: AIRSPEED_MIN = AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 17 m/s: the planning case while the tripped stall (12.85 m/s) is the baseline, until T-B2-STALL
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-96 (c): 17 holds to a 13.07 m/s stall; review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-SUMMARY.md decision B6 makes it the planning baseline. performance.cruise_ms stays 16 until A1 changes it

nodes.title: Second bound: the maker's top row is a true 14.8 V full-throttle point
nodes.text: the maker's 30 A row (7 500 rpm, 1 580 gf, 11x4.7, 94 degC) was taken at 14.8 V at the ESC and 100 % duty. The station then has an effective series resistance R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m at that row (winding at its 94 degC, ESC and everything the simple model leaves out), used unchanged at other bus voltages and with the 11x5.5MR
nodes.basis: CDR-AE-01 (review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-aero.md): the 'sagging supply' reading of the rows above 12 A has no evidence, so the rows are a second bound, not discarded data. A fixed series resistance is the simplest model that reproduces the row; the reviewer's cruder rule (full-throttle rpm proportional to bus voltage) is carried beside it as a sensitivity. T-E1-STAND with a logged bus voltage decides between the bounds

nodes.title: Low stand point: bus held at 11.9 V
nodes.text: bench supply held at 11.9 V at the ESC pads for the worst-state full-throttle run of T-E1-STAND
nodes.basis: CDR condition B-7 / CDR-AE C1 (review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-SUMMARY.md): >= 1 060 gf at an 11.9 V bus; 11.9 V is CALC-E1-WORST's worst-state bus on the first bound (11.85 V at r_ext 6.7 mOhm)

nodes.title: Transition thrust margin 1.3
nodes.text: full thrust at every point of the level pitch-over corridor >= 1.3 x the thrust that holds level unaccelerated flight there
nodes.basis: 0.3 g of surplus for acceleration and gusts; same headroom as ASM-A2-GUST-THRUST-HEADROOM

nodes.title: Wing CL: linear to CLmax, flat plate after stall
nodes.text: CL = a alpha up to CLmax (a = 2 pi AR/(AR+2)); above stall CN = 1.98 sin(alpha) (flat plate); prop wash on the wing ignored
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat-plate normal force; ignoring wash lift is conservative for thrust required; B1/B2 refine

nodes.title: Worst pack state for hover T/W
nodes.text: the lowest pack state the aircraft is flown in: the 20 % reserve line (E2 ASM-E2-OCV-20), pack cold-soaked to 10 degC (E2 ASM-E2-COLD-R), windings hot (80 degC, after a hover), 100 A limiter set; pack resistance = cells x R_cell x cold + R_ext (E2's model)
nodes.basis: one definition shared with E2 (CR-E2/E1 reconciliation 2026-11-09); the battery failsafe lands the aircraft at the reserve line, so states below it are emergencies, reported as a sensitivity (3.60 V/cell OCV)

nodes.title: Prop stack dimensions
nodes.text: motor body (mount face to bell top) 26.5 mm; bolt-on adapter base 6.35 mm, M6x1 post 15.2 mm above the base; prop hub 0.35 in = 8.89 mm; M6 washer 1.0 mm; M6 hex nut ISO 4032 5.2 mm
nodes.basis: HiModel listing (body), Small Parts CNC adapter drawing values, APC 11x5.5MR page (hub), ISO 4032 / ISO 7089 (nut, washer); measure the supplied adapter on arrival

nodes.title: Motor screw length and engagement window
nodes.text: M3x8 SHCS (A2 stainless, same size as the old design's F01), no washer; thread engagement in the motor base 2.5-3.5 mm (>= 5 threads, tip clear of the stator). The plate and pad heights under the head are D3's (P:fin_detail.mount.*)
nodes.basis: X3108S base thread depth is not published: 3.5 mm is a conservative limit for a 31 mm stator base; probe the hole depth on arrival, the screw tip must stop >= 0.5 mm short of the bottom

nodes.title: Per-unit flying masses incl. leads, g
nodes.text: motor with factory leads 81.0 (no bullets: harness HRN-E03); ESC stripped of its factory power leads (F2 solders its own 16 AWG to the pads, D-48, CR-F2-07) with signal lead and heat-shrink 7.6 (6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g; was 11.0 with 2 x 80 mm 16 AWG); prop 17.0; bolt-on adapter 3.0 + 4 x M3x4 1.2 + M6 nut 1.9 + washer 0.6 = 6.7; 4 x M3x8 SHCS motor screws 3.2
nodes.basis: listings (81 g, 17 g, 3.0 g); ISO masses for screws, nuts, washers; the stripped ESC is EST from the 6.6 g bare board (D-48, CR-A3-21: -3.4 g per ESC); weigh everything on arrival

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row) ; rows > 12 A (second bound): V_supply,min = V_m + I_m R_esc at the measured rpm, R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = 1 ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Pack-current limit that holds 25 A in the winding (11x5.5MR, fresh pack)
nodes.equation: solve I_lim: I_m(largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim) = I_rating ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) at that limit, fresh (4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC winding)

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Path resistance and 100 A voltage drop the thrust requirement allows
nodes.equation: R_allow = min over the two bounds and the two cases of the R_ext at which T/W_worst(R_ext) = T/W_min,sag or T/W_fresh(R_ext) = T/W_min (bisection on the cases of CALC-E1-WORST and CALC-E1-BOUND2) ; drop_allow = 100 I_lim R_allow / V_nom ; thrust cost of the path = 1 - T_worst(R_ext) / T_worst(0)

nodes.title: Second bound: the maker's rows above 12 A read as true 14.8 V points (11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: R_eff from the maker's 30 A row (CALC-E1-CAL) replaces R_m + R_esc ; then as CALC-E1-WORST: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim, T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; sensitivity (CDR-AE-01 rule): rpm_full = rpm_full(14.8 V held) x V_bus / 14.8 ; stand point: bus held at V_stand ; T_need = T/W_min,sag m / (4 cos cant)

nodes.title: Prop stack, prop-to-structure gap, nut and motor-screw engagement
nodes.equation: s = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer - h_nut ; gap = face_ahead + s >= 0.14 D (B4) ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate (D3 R3: plate canted with the motor, uniform under every head)

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point on B1's polar: four props share the drag
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim (B1's as-designed polar, = CALC-B1V-CRUISE drag_gate_n) ; T_m = D / 4 ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat ; L/D_eff = W / D ; p_check = (P_55 + avionics) / B1 gate power

nodes.title: Cruise point at the 17 m/s fallback speed (D-96 c, B6), 11x5.5MR
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-CRUISE at V = 17 m/s: D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; T_m = D / 4 ; P = 4 P_bat(T_m, J) ; ratio = P(17) / P(cruise_ms)

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: min over V in [0, V_tr] of 4 T_full(V cos a, OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC) / T_req,min(V) ; T_req from T sin a + L = W, T cos a >= D ; polar CL-B1V-CD0, CL-B1V-K, ASM-B1-TRIM (rev 8)

nodes.title: One motor out: what is left (11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: hover: thrust/moment balance forces the diagonal partner to 0 -> 2 same-direction motors, T/W_2 = 2 T_max,worst / W, unbalanced yaw torque = 2 Q_hover ; cruise: 2 motors carry D, roll torque = 2 Q(T = D/2) for elevons to hold

nodes.title: Motor winding current at the 100 A limiter, fresh pack, 11x5.5MR (model)
nodes.how: T-E1-STAND / GT-04: phase current with a clamp on one motor lead (true-RMS, or the ESC's phase-current telemetry) during the 100 A limiter run, with bell temperature; not the ESC input lead.
nodes.note: CDR-05 (CDR-AE-02, decision B7): re-stated on the WINDING (phase) current. Until 2026-11-13 this id held the battery-side share of the limiter (24.75 A, now CL-E1-ILIM-I-BAT), which is not what the maker's 25 A / 30 s rating limits. At the limiter the ESC runs at a duty of about 0.83 (CALC-E1-LIMIT duty_fresh_55), so the winding carries about I_bat / duty. Fresh case of CALC-E1-WORST (4.20 V/cell, E2's cell resistance: the case behind the fresh T/W of 2.5); CALC-E1-LIMIT's older fresh case reads 0.5 A less (I_wind_fresh_55_A). FAILS as posed: the limiter value is decided on the stand (B7): keep 100 A only if a 30 s run holds the bell <= 80 degC, else the value of CL-E1-ILIM-FOR-25A. Second bound: CL-E1-ILIM-I-B2

nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station, both candidate props
nodes.procedure: H1 stand (20 kg cell + HX711), X3108S + LANRC 45 A, 11x4.5MR then 11x5.5MR; held 14.8 V bench supply (>= 40 A) and then a flight pack; 10 % throttle steps to 100 %, 3 s each; log gf, A, V, rpm (optical tach or ESC telemetry), can temperature; one 60 s run at 689 gf for g/W; ten 10 -> 100 % throttle punches in < 50 ms with no desync. CDR-04 / CDR-05 additions: bus voltage logged at the ESC pads on every run; full throttle at a held 14.6 V and 11.9 V bus (pass >= 1 330 gf and >= 1 060 gf); phase current on one motor lead (clamp or ESC telemetry) at the limiter duty; one 30 s run at the limiter with the bell temperature (pass <= 80 degC, else the limiter drops to CL-E1-ILIM-FOR-25A)

nodes.title: Incoming check: resistance, no-load current, mass, bolt pattern, hole and thread depth
nodes.procedure: Weigh motor, stripped ESC, prop, adapter set (0.1 g); calipers: base diameter (D3 needs >= 28 mm), base bolt pattern (D3 prints 16 x 19 mm), base hole depth (>= 4.0 mm, CL-E1-HOLE-DEPTH-MIN), bell-top thread length (>= 2.5 mm for D-58; >= 3.0 mm with >= 4.0 mm free depth -> M3x5, CR-A4-43), adapter flange under the screw head, motor phase-lead length from the base (F2's routed reach 0.121 m, CL-F2-PHASE-REACH: if the leads reach, no splice and F2 returns 12 g), ESC strapped on a printed pad (height proud), body length, adapter base and post; on the first built station a printed 25 mm gauge between the blade's aft face at the tip and the CF tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (R-PROP-CLEAR); 4-wire: 2.00 A from a bench supply through two phases, read the voltage drop (R = V / I); no-load current and rpm at 10.0 V without prop (Kv = rpm / (V - I0 R))

nodes.title: Tethered hover current
nodes.procedure: XPS aircraft at 2.6 kg, 30 s tethered hover; pack current from the power module; can temperature by IR at landing
